name: skill-map
description: A 📕 button above the prompt opens every installed skill and slash command, grouped and coloured, with the model's picks for this session on top.

overridesFile.title: Group overrides file
overridesFile.description: JSON mapping a skill name to a group name. These win over the model's sorting.

quickButtons.title: Quick buttons beside the book
quickButtons.description: Comma-separated label=action:skill. run runs the skill at once; type puts it in the prompt box for you to finish.

model.title: Model for sorting and suggestions
model.description: An alias such as haiku, or a full model id.
